title: Record maintenance issues identified after tenant checkout
gherkin:
Feature: Post-rent maintenance handling
  Scenario: Record maintenance issues identified after tenant checkout
    Given a rental period has ended
    When maintenance staff inspect the property
    And identify maintenance issues
    Then the issues should be recorded in the maintenance system
    And each issue should include description, location, and severity
rationale: Post-rent maintenance begins with identifying and documenting issues found during property inspection after tenant departure. This is the foundational step for all subsequent maintenance activities.
generationSummary: Post-rent maintenance handling covers the processes and workflows for managing maintenance activities after a rental period ends. This includes documenting maintenance needs, scheduling repairs, tracking completion, and ensuring properties are properly maintained between tenants.

title: Prioritize maintenance tasks by severity
gherkin:
Feature: Post-rent maintenance handling
  Scenario: Prioritize maintenance tasks by severity
    Given maintenance issues have been recorded
    When the system evaluates issue severity levels
    Then critical issues should be marked for immediate attention
    And non-critical issues should be scheduled for later completion
rationale: Maintenance tasks need to be prioritized to ensure urgent repairs are addressed first, preventing further property damage and ensuring readiness for next tenant.
generationSummary: Post-rent maintenance handling covers the processes and workflows for managing maintenance activities after a rental period ends. This includes documenting maintenance needs, scheduling repairs, tracking completion, and ensuring properties are properly maintained between tenants.
